scope: Static native Z80 post-visible phase F476 to F019 and named mechanics slices; not a whole-game or natural-collision contract

cpu.observable_flags: Only published mechanics stops and explicit arithmetic/RMW/clear/phase stops returned by observable_stops(); adding a stop requires regeneration

bus.decode: 6507 physical address & 1FFF; separate read and write mirrors; zero-page indexes wrap at 256
bus.data: Source FC00..FFFF only; 1024 bytes local/ignored, not the complete original ROM

checks: Independent py65 1.2.0 NMOS execution versus actual standard-speed openMSX Z80
All A/X/Y/P/SP and all 128 RAM bytes, including source JSR return-byte writes
Final per-step hardware write shadows; event ordering/audio/timing at the original bus is outside this proof
Four 192-step continuous native chains retain their own previous RAM/CPU; only named contact and hardware inputs are injected
All 256 bounded zero-clear start indexes, indexed hardware wraps, entry stack bounds, decimal/flag corner cases
Complete records, stack/heap guards, 64 KiB RAM, 3579545 Hz, source/binary/helper/backend identity
contacts: Declared scripted B0..B9 and ED inputs; these are fixtures, not implemented collision acquisition

input.sampler: Direct standard MSX1 PSG/PPI ports; raw opposing states retained; keyboard joins only C7-selected port0/1
input.preservation: AF/BC/DE/HL/IX/IY/SP, source V/mode, full PSG15, PPI-C and slots; DI retained
input.port_setup: Release PSG15 bits0..3 and lower both common/strobe bits4/5 while sampling; restore exact prior outputs afterward
input.console: Held F1 Reset/F2 Select; F3 and other keys do not toggle original difficulty bits
input.tests: 1354 actual-device cases, all16raw combinations, both ports, mixed keyboard/joysticks,768continuous steps with declared contacts; poisoned hardware mirrors and deliberately inverted port2 fire

artifacts: outputs/native/ is ignored; native-contract.rom is an internal RPC CPU proof, not an offered human diagnostic
timing: Raw CPU proof cycles do not certify integrated input/mapper/render/PAL capacity
